jobs.descriptionHtml:
Quick answer: Honeywell Internship 2027 now has three live intern openings in Bengaluru: the “Intern (Bachelor’s)” role 162285 (IT Analysis, posted 20 November), the Software Eng intern (160484) and the AI intern (161319). All three are for students still pursuing a Bachelor’s degree. Req 162285 closes on 23 November at 3:09 PM IST, so apply to it first. Stipend and duration are not published.

Honeywell Internship 2027 – full job details

The Honeywell Internship 2027 list on Honeywell’s Oracle careers portal now has three open roles. On 20 November Honeywell opened req 162285 (Devarabisanahalli, Varthur Hobli), titled Intern (Bachelor’s), under the job function “IT Analysis”.

Alongside it, the earlier Software Eng intern req 160484 and AI intern req 161319 are still accepting applications. Listings we covered earlier that have since closed have been removed from this page. Every role is a University Relations hire for Bengaluru.

Expected stipend: The Honeywell Internship 2027 listings do not publish a stipend for any role. Bengaluru intern listings on job boards suggest roughly ₹25,000–45,000 a month, but the sample is small, so treat it as a rough guide and ask the recruiter for the exact figure in writing.

Current students only: every Honeywell Internship 2027 listing asks for someone still pursuing (or enrolled in) a Bachelor’s degree. If you have already graduated, these internships are not meant for you.

Template gaps in listing 162285: the short description of 162285 still shows unfilled placeholders for the manager title, city and work mode, and the “must have” line only says experience in a similar field “should be enough”. Confirm the work mode, team and duration once you are contacted.

What you will do in the Honeywell Internship 2027 role

The Intern (Bachelor’s) listing 162285 describes general support work rather than a fixed tech stack:

  • Help the team with routine tasks and ongoing projects
  • Work on data analysis and prepare reports
  • Research topics and collect information for projects
  • Coordinate with teams from other functions
  • Take part in team meetings and offer ideas

The Software Eng intern (160484) focuses on applying software engineering basics, joining code reviews and building software with cross-functional teams. The AI intern (161319) only has a short summary: helping design and build AI algorithms, models and systems alongside AI engineers.

Honeywell Internship 2027 eligibility

  • Intern (Bachelor’s) 162285: pursuing a Bachelor’s in a relevant field such as Engineering, Business or Computer Science; analytical and problem-solving ability; comfort working in a team
  • Software Eng 160484: enrolled in a Bachelor’s in Software Engineering or a related field, with a basic grasp of software development; Java, Python or C++ is valued
  • AI 161319: no detailed qualification list is published; the summary points to interest in AI models and systems
  • Not confirmed: graduation year, CGPA cut-off, backlog rules and branch restrictions are not stated in any listing

Honeywell Internship 2027 selection process

Honeywell has not published the selection process for the Honeywell Internship 2027 roles. Based on how its campus-style intern hiring usually runs, plan for these stages:

  1. Resume shortlisting against the listing
  2. An online assessment (aptitude, logic and basic coding for tech roles)
  3. One or two technical or functional interviews
  4. An HR or manager conversation about availability and fit

How to apply for Honeywell Internship 2027

  1. Start with req 162285 because it closes first: apply for Honeywell Intern (Bachelor’s) 162285 before 23 November, 3:09 PM IST
  2. Software students can also apply for Software Eng intern 160484, and AI-focused students for AI intern 161319
  3. Sign in or create a Honeywell candidate profile, upload your resume and answer the screening questions

Each Honeywell Internship 2027 requisition is a separate application, and Honeywell does not say whether they share one shortlist, so apply to every role that fits you.

About Honeywell

Honeywell is a US-headquartered industrial technology company working across aerospace, building automation, industrial automation and energy. Its Bengaluru campuses host large engineering and IT teams, and the Honeywell Internship 2027 roles give students a first look at how those teams work.
